request.initial_prompt: In the United States, therefore, the mass of the institutions of the country is essentially republican; and in order permanently to destroy the laws which form the basis of the republic, it would be necessary to abolish all the laws at once. At the present day it would be even more difficult for a party to succeed in founding a monarchy in the United States than for a set of men to proclaim that France should henceforward be a republic. Royalty would not find a system of legislation prepared for it beforehand; and a monarchy would then exist, really surrounded by republican institutions. The monarchical principle would likewise have great difficulty in penetrating into the manners of the Americans.

raw_segments.text: In the United States, therefore, the mass of the institutions of the country is essentially republican and in order permanently to destroy the laws which form the basis of the republic, it would be necessary to abolish all the laws at once.
At the present day it would be even more difficult for a party to succeed in founding a monarchy in the United States than for a set of men to proclaim that France should henceforward be a republic.
Royalty would not find a system of legislation prepared for it beforehand, and a monarchy would then exist, really surrounded by republican institutions.
The monarchical principle would likewise have great difficulty in penetrating into the manners of the Americans.
